name: op_get_accessibility_tree
description: THE ACCESSIBILITY TREE, as a screen reader holds it. `get_accessibility_tree` answers the tree the engine last published to the platform adapter: every node with its role, name, description, value, language, states, bounds, children and parent, and the focus. It is what scripts/a11y_e2e.py walks forwards and backwards, and what it checks every interactive node for a role and a translated name. BEAT 1 - a page with a heading, a named icon button and a text button: the tree names them (the declared name wins over the glyph inside the button) and the root is the window. BEAT 2 - nothing is focused, so the published focus is the window root (id 0).

css: #root { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: "Azul Mock Mono"; font-size: 16px; }
